subject: english
question:
**Select the most appropriate option to complete the given sentence.**

He booked the tickets for the show _____.
solution: The correct answer is: **in advance** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • **'In advance' **is a phrase that means **ahead in time.** (अग्रिम रूप से) • Example: You need to book weeks in advance. • As per the meaning of the given words, **"in** **advance**" is the best fit for the given sentence. • The implied meaning of the sentence is: *He reserved the show's tickets ahead of time.* • Therefore, the correct answer is **option 4**. **The complete sentence will be:** *He booked the tickets for the show in advance__.* * [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__*** • Let us look at the meaning of the other words. • Demand: To ask for something forcefully, in a way that shows that you do not expect to be refused. (मांग) • Common: Belonging equally to, or shared alike by two or more subjects. (सामान्य) • Depth: The state of having serious qualities or the ability to think seriously about something. (गंभीर गुण होने की अवस्था या किसी चीज़ के बारे में गंभीरता से सोचने की क्षमता) 35:Tc70, The correct answer is: **It becomes easily and quickly achievable**
